notes: 修复插件更新安装失败：0.4.20 起改用 pnpm publish 发包，npm 兜底源下到的包顶层目录是「包名/」而不是 npm 标准的「package/」，旧安装器只认 package/ 导致「安装包结构不对」。更新器现兼容两种结构（npm package/ 与 pnpm 重打包 包名/），覆盖 post-exit / install-plugin / apply 三处解包点。
notesEn: Fix plugin update installation: since 0.4.20 packages are published via pnpm, whose repacked tarball has a top-level <name>/ directory instead of npm's standard package/. The installer only accepted package/ and failed with 'unexpected package structure'. The updater now accepts both layouts (npm package/ and pnpm repacked <name>/) across post-exit / install-plugin / apply extraction points.
